paras: Step up your Nissan GT-R R35 's rear braking performance with DIXCEL FS-Series two-piece brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. The FS-Series represents DIXCEL's premium two-piece rotor line, combining a lightweight aluminium centre hat with a precision-cast iron friction ring for reduced unsprung mass, improved thermal management, and superior performance over single-piece OEM rotors under demanding street and circuit conditions.

This listing covers a matched left and right pair of DIXCEL FS two-piece 380x30mm vented rear brake rotors (part number FS-38030B26R/27L) designed for all generations of the Nissan GT-R R35 , from the original 2007 launch through to current production. Unlike the front rotor which differs between CBA and DBA chassis variants, the rear brake hardware has remained consistent across the entire R35 production run, making this listing a universal R35 rear rotor fitment.
